decisions.label: Complete Remission
decisions.description: The disappearance of all signs of cancer in response to treatment.

verification.note: NCIT:C4870 Complete Remission; NCIT uses 'Remission' rather than 'Response' as the label, but the definition explicitly describes disappearance of all signs in response to treatment — the correct concept for Complete Response treatment outcome.

decisions.label: No Evidence of Disease
decisions.description: Diagnostic tests fail to detect presence of disease.

verification.note: NCIT:C40413 No Evidence of Disease; exact label match.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Assessed
decisions.description: Indicates that an assessment was not performed.

verification.note: NCIT:C139527 Not Assessed; label differs ('Not Assessed' vs 'Not Evaluable') but both indicate the response was not measured or cannot be determined. Best available NCIT qualifier.
NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Partial Remission
decisions.description: A finding indicating that there is a decrease in the size and the extent of tissue involvement by a malignant tumor in a patient.

verification.note: NCIT:C18058 Partial Remission; NCIT uses 'Remission' rather than 'Response' but the definition describes tumor decrease in response to treatment — the correct concept for Partial Response.

decisions.label: Residual Disease
decisions.description: The persistence of tumor cells in the body following cancer treatment.

verification.note: NCIT:C4809 Residual Disease; label differs ('Residual' vs 'Persistent') but the definition explicitly describes persistence of tumor cells after treatment — the correct concept. No generic 'Persistent Disease' term exists in NCIT.

decisions.label: Progressive Disease
decisions.description: A clinical, pathologic, and/or molecular finding indicating that the course of a disease is worsening.

verification.note: NCIT:C35571 Progressive Disease; exact label match.

decisions.label: Stable Disease
decisions.description: A disease that is neither decreasing nor increasing in extent or severity.

verification.note: NCIT:C18213 Stable Disease; exact label match.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.
